fields.Name: T132 - Action Explorer Status Type Filter and Sort
fields.Description: Bespoke checkbox multi-select Status/Type filter + in-popover sort with a custom applyFilters()/sortActions() pipeline and StatusTypeFilterCount badge — distinct from the generic grid's advanced filter builder.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, switch to the 'Actions' application, and open the 'Explorer' nav item. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. In the toolbar, open the Filters popover (funnel/filter icon). It contains a Status section (Active / Pending / Disabled checkboxes), a Type section (AI Generated / Custom), and a Sort section. Toggle a Status checkbox and verify the action list RESPONDS (rows narrow to matches or a clear no-results empty-state appears) and the filter count badge updates. Then pick a different Sort field and verify the list re-orders. Seeing the list respond to the filter and sort is success.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Filters popover opens and shows Status, Type, and Sort sections with selectable options
Toggling a Status or Type option narrows the list OR shows a valid no-results state, and an active-filter count indicator appears
Choosing a different Sort field visibly changes the ordering of the action list (or is accepted without error when the list is empty)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
